notes: One entry per physical filament (brand + line + color). Codes are MATERIAL-COLOR-NN and never reused.
presets: the Bambu Studio SYSTEM filament preset each printer starts from - copy exact names from the bambu-studio-settings skill's list_presets.py.

tuned.<printer>.filament: settings that belong to the filament (temperatures, flow ratio, pressure advance, retraction, fan). Put them in a filament user preset (make_preset.py --type filament) or in a project's filament settings (tune_project.py plate spec). Never in a process preset.

tuned.<printer>.process: settings that live in the process but were tuned for this filament (x-y hole/contour compensation, elephant foot compensation, seam, top layers, ironing, overhang/bridge speeds). Put them in the project (tune_project.py plate spec) or a process user preset named after the filament.
Every override value carries 'tests': the ids of the tile prints in 'tests' that justify it.
status: untested (nothing printed), baseline (tile printed at system preset, verdict recorded), tuned (at least one override confirmed by a reprint).
